```python
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Count word frequencies in a UTF-8 text file."""

import argparse
import re
import sys
from collections import Counter


def positive_int(value):
    try:
        n = int(value)
    except ValueError:
        raise argparse.ArgumentTypeError(f"{value!r} is not an integer")
    if n < 1:
        raise argparse.ArgumentTypeError(f"must be a positive integer, got {n}")
    return n


WORD_RE = re.compile(r"(?:[^\W\d_]|\')+")


def tokenize(text):
    for m in WORD_RE.finditer(text):
        word = m.group(0).strip("\'").lower()
        if word:
            yield word


def main(argv=None):
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(
        description="Print the most frequent words in FILE.")
    parser.add_argument("file", help="input file to read as UTF-8")
    parser.add_argument("-n", type=positive_int, default=10, metavar="N",
                        help="number of words to print (default: 10)")
    parser.add_argument("--min-len", type=int, default=1, metavar="K",
                        help="ignore words shorter than K characters (default: 1)")
    args = parser.parse_args(argv)

    try:
        with open(args.file, encoding="utf-8") as fh:
            text = fh.read()
    except (OSError, UnicodeDecodeError):
        print(f"error: cannot read {args.file}", file=sys.stderr)
        return 1

    counts = Counter(w for w in tokenize(text) if len(w) >= args.min_len)
    for word, count in sorted(counts.items(), key=lambda kv: (-kv[1], kv[0]))[: args.n]:
        print(f"{word} {count}")
    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main())
```

Combining marks\n# belong to the letter they attach to, so they stay inside the run.\nWORD_RE = re.compile(r\"(?:[^\\W\\d_]|\\')+\")\n\n\ndef positive_int(value):\n    \"\"\"Argparse type: accept only positive integers (else usage error, exit 2).\"\"\"\n    try:\n        n = int(value)\n    except ValueError:\n        raise argparse.ArgumentTypeError(f\"{value!r} is not an integer\")\n    if n < 1:\n        raise argparse.ArgumentTypeError(f\"must be a positive integer, got {n}\")\n    return n\n\n\ndef tokenize(text):\n    \"\"\"Yield lower-cased words with outer apostrophes removed.\"\"\"\n    for match in WORD_RE.finditer(text):\n        word = match.group(0).strip(\"\\'\").lower()\n        if word:\n            yield word\n\n\ndef main(argv=None):\n    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(\n        description=\"Print the N most frequent words in FILE, ties broken \"\n                    \"alphabetically.\")\n    parser.add_argument(\"file\", help=\"input file, read as UTF-8\")\n    parser.add_argument(\"-n\", type=positive_int, default=10, metavar=\"N\",\n                        help=\"number of words to print (default: 10)\")\n    parser.add_argument(\"--min-len\", type=int, default=1, metavar=\"K\",\n                        help=\"ignore words shorter than K characters \"\n                             \"(default: 1)\")\n    args = parser.parse_args(argv)\n\n    try:\n        with open(args.file, encoding=\"utf-8\") as fh:\n            text = fh.read()\n    except (OSError, UnicodeDecodeError):\n        print(f\"error: cannot read {args.file}\", file=sys.stderr)\n        return 1\n\n    counts = Counter(w for w in tokenize(text) if len(w) >= args.min_len)\n    ranked = sorted(counts.items(), key=lambda kv: (-kv[1], kv[0]))\n    for word, count in ranked[: args.n]:\n        print(f\"{word} {count}\")\n    return 0\n\n\nif __name__ == \"__main__\":\n    sys.exit(main())\n"}"]]}
